cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry it over as well. What does that favour get me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save your friend two sausages, then. You can choose which two.

reason: A adds carrying work and reduces priority to two sausages with B selection, treating friendship as a priced return rather than a theme.
